name: Unity Of God
overview: The unity of God is affirmed in Scripture as a foundational truth, demonstrated by His unparalleled acts in creation and redemption. Deuteronomy 4 highlights God's unique sovereignty and singularity, declaring that there is no other God besides Him, who revealed Himself through mighty signs and wonders to His people. This truth calls for exclusive obedience and wholehearted devotion, emphasizing that the LORD alone is God in heaven and on earth, worthy of worship and faithful obedience for the well-being of His people.
